text:
maya.p: Heads-up 50min ago50 - Customer (BlueWave Financial) says Azure Marketplace PO failed ingestion: portal returned "signature_envelope_encoding_mismatch" and won't accept their signed bundle. They need capacity this week. :alarm_clock:
samir.s: BlueWave procurement insists on their AdobeSign ZIP workflow; they will not change upstream. Sales escalated; customer will withhold start-of-contract without this PO accepted.
orion.ops: Can you paste the raw error?
maya.p: `422 Unprocessable Entity {"error":"signature_envelope_encoding_mismatch","detail":"expected encoding base64url, got base64 padding present"}`
devon.eng: That indicates our unzip+normalizer removed padding bytes on some signature blocks. We recently changed canonicalization to strip trailing � and padding for filenames.
marketplace-bot: deploy 2026-03-18 libarchive change (commit d9a1c4) - filename/payload canonicalization relaxed -> potential signature byte differences.
orion.ops: Ops risk: preserving every byte means larger storage and potential zip-bomb vectors. We'll need quotas and a scanner.
anil.legal: If we accept modified signed bytes we could be in trouble for regulated finance customers. Options: 1) provide an opt-in raw-ingest route with written waiver + audit trail, or 2) add a reversible-preservation mode that stores original blob for compliance review.
rachel.s: Customer timeline: needs a green-path within 48h or contract staging delayed. Sales needs solution + signed waiver.
devon.eng: Quick tech plan: add header `X-Redwood-Preserve-Signature: true` to ingestion API to bypass normalization and stream original bytes to blobstore. Estimate: 1 eng, 1.5 days; add zip-scan 0.5d. Canary toggleable at edge.
orion.ops: Ops estimate: 4h to wire feature-flag routing + quota enforcement, and safety hooks for scanning. Can enable for single tenant.
anil.legal: I'll draft a short waiver: "By enabling raw-signature ingestion BlueWave acknowledges Redwood will persist original signed artifacts without modification for the purpose of PO acceptance; BlueWave remains responsible for signature validity and indemnifies Redwood for signature disputes." Need explicit signed reply from customer.
maya.p: I'll ask BlueWave to sign waiver now on the call. Samir - please confirm acceptance immed.
samir.s: On the call, pushing for immediate ACK. If they sign, ops/eng can enable canary traffic tonight.
marketplace-bot: created MP-6233 "azure-preserve-signature-canary" assigned to @devon.eng.
devon.eng: I'll open PR tonight for the header + preserve path, link to MP-6233.
maya.p: Thanks all. Once waiver lands I'll paste signed copy here and ops will flip the canary. :thumbsup:
